C1138.title: Tongliao Police Uncover a Virtual-Currency Money-Laundering Case
C1138.summary: In December 2022, China Peace reported that the Horqin District Public Security Bureau in Tongliao, Inner Mongolia, had uncovered a virtual-currency money-laundering case. Beginning in May 2021, the group recruited participants through Telegram, converted proceeds from pyramid schemes, fraud, and gambling into USDT, and returned funds to upstream criminal groups. Police arrested 63 people, seized about 130 million yuan in illegal proceeds, and identified 12 billion yuan in transaction flows.
